notes.title: "June 12" Game release date confirmed & Reveal the first abnormal dimension
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

Thank you for your long wait.🙇🏻‍♂️

Now I have finally finished this game and dealt with a lot of funding issues. (I need money to make games T_T

The game will be officially released on June 12, 2025.

Every week from now on there will be a teaser of one of the anomalous dimensions, the bosses.
Go check it out!!!😈
[previewyoutube=CLVoYoRVF04;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Major Update Version 1.1 : Optimization
notes.notes:
Major Update Version 1.1 : Optimization

[list]
[*]Around Double Game's Frame Rate
[*]Remove shadow and ray tracing for many objects
[*]Change lighting setting for Medium and High Setting
[*]Force Main Menu 30 FPS
[*]Fix Stuck At Pause or Setting Menu
[*]Increase Floor 303 anomaly speed
[*]Fix Floor 400-416 mirror reflection difference for player with different setting 
[/list]
